# appdynamics_schedules (Data Source)

Lists the alerting schedules defined for an AppDynamics business application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_schedules" "all" {
  application_id = 42
}

output "schedule_names" {
  value = { for s in data.appdynamics_schedules.all.schedules : s.id => s.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application to list schedules for.

### Read-Only

- `schedules` (Attributes List) The schedules defined for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) Schedule ID.
- `name` (String)
- `timezone` (String)
